grade_basis: static structural agreement between code-discovery sources (heuristic boundaries)

limitations.text: Not every agreeing source is independent (census <- ghidra:2c80bf9dfade293e).
Census structure is statically derived from Ghidra references; function boundaries and attribution are heuristic.
Source agreement is structural consistency between analysis sources about where code and functions are; it does not establish behavior, and a source coverage gap is not negative evidence.
